meta.title: Images: upload, publish, display and delete

segments.label: 1 · Upload: the UI talks to c2c_images directly
2 · Save: the API publishes what it stores

messages.label: POST images.camptocamp.org/upload
messages.note: Before sending, a Worker reduces the photo to 3072 px on its long side (panoramas: 2048 px short side, 16 MP), JPEG 0.9. One upload at a time.

messages.label: Varnish buffers the body → round robin
messages.note: maxconn 2 per instance; client address in X-Forwarded-For.

messages.label: PUT original + SI/MI/BI (JPEG/PNG)
messages.note: Checks the format: HEIC → JPEG, WebP/AVIF/TIFF/GIF → JPEG/PNG, SVG sanitized; ≤ 100 MP (HEIC 50). Renamed <timestamp>_<random>.<ext>.

messages.label: POST /images/list
messages.note: One image document per file, with its filename and associations (outing, route...).

messages.label: POST /publish {secret, filename}
messages.note: Through haproxy:8081 (internal_images), inside the request: a non-200 answer gives a 500 and nothing is saved. Also when an update changes the filename.

messages.label: move original + all thumbnails
messages.note: Incoming → active. An AVIF not rendered yet is moved 20 s later (THUMBNAILS_PUBLISH_DELAY).

messages.label: GET media.camptocamp.org/c2corg-active/<name>MI.avif
messages.note: <picture>: AVIF for images uploaded after modernThumbnailsTimestamp, else (or on error) the JPEG/PNG thumbnail.

messages.label: anonymous GET (backend s3)
messages.note: Anonymous reads of the bucket are only accepted from the HAProxies.

messages.label: GET /images/proxy/{id}?size=MI&extension=avif
messages.note: When only the document id is known; follows merged images to their target.

messages.label: POST /delete {secret, filenames[]}
messages.note: After commit, when an image document is deleted or merged: every filename of its archives. A failure is only logged.

messages.label: DELETE each original + thumbnails
messages.note: Versioned bucket: only a delete marker, recoverable for 30 days.

messages.label: expire unpublished files after 24 h
messages.note: A lifecycle rule of the bucket, created at startup if missing; else an hourly sweep by the service.

cards.title: Files of one image
items: Original, at most 3072 px long side (panoramas 2048 px short side, 16 MP)
BI 1500×1500 and MI 400×400 fit inside; SI 200×200 cropped
Thumbnails in JPEG (mozjpeg 82) or PNG, plus AVIF; SVG originals get JPEG thumbnails

cards.title: Protection of c2corg-active
items: Only copy of every published image
Versioning: a delete or an overwrite keeps the previous version for 30 days
The bucket policy forbids purging versions or turning the protection off
Anonymous reads restricted to the HAProxies: the public goes through media.camptocamp.org

cards.title: Recent changes (November 2026)
items: AVIF thumbnails; HEIC, WebP, AVIF, TIFF and GIF uploads converted
Originals reduced to the limits, in the UI and again by the service
Incoming files expire after 24 h; c2corg-active versioned and read only through HAProxy

cards.title: Not drawn
items: Preprod: c2corg-preprod-incoming/-active; a missing file redirects to production's media
POST /rotate exists but the API does not call it: the UI rotates and uploads again
Scripts: AVIF backfill and re-rendering of published originals
